title: mm configuration: registries
description: Image registries and the credentials deploys pull with, by host.
$comment: The value of top-level 'registries', for .config/mm/registries.yaml. Generated from MmConfig; run ./scripts/generate-artifacts.sh. Do not edit.

RegistryConfig.description: A registry, keyed by its host (`ghcr.io`, `registry.example.com:5000`).

password.description: The secret holding the password or access token; set it per environment.

username.description: The account the token belongs to. GHCR accepts any name with a token.
